title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell XLII-S); Transfer Info: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture with a stellar setlist, though Brent’s keyboard mic is missing.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave that this FOB (front‑of‑house) recording sounds as good as it gets, giving both the set list and the audio five stars. The only technical gripe is the complete lack of a microphone for Brent Mydland, leaving his keyboards and background vocals absent. Overall the show is described as a must‑hear experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed review rates both performance and sound at five stars, indicating an exceptional show and recording despite the missing Brent mic.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp front‑of‑house mix praised as top‑notch; however no microphone was set up for Brent Mydland, resulting in missing keyboard and background vocal presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set list receives five‑star praise; flow described as strong and satisfying.

band_member_comments.Keys: No microphone was set up for Brent Mydland, so his keyboards and background vocals are absent in this recording.
